_comment: SSOT for external (non-npm) binaries the gate uses. CI installs these (see .github/workflows/01-pr-fast.yml); scripts/install-ci-tools.mjs installs the identical pinned versions to ~/.local/bin so a local gate runs the SAME tools as CI. scripts/check-ci-tool-parity.mjs enforces manifest <-> CI <-> gate alignment. These are curl-installed, NOT GitHub Action `uses:` pins, so sync-action-pins.mjs (INV-76) does not cover them — this manifest is their only version pin.
